hyperedges.description: The multi-panel loss chart jointly reports four loss components from a single akbar_arabic_rock_lora run.

Five TRAINING_ANALYSIS charts jointly document the observability of the akbar_arabic_rock_lora training run: loss decomposition, primary loss trend, LR schedule, throughput/sample pauses, and GPU telemetry.
Loss, throughput, and GPU telemetry charts together characterize the same run, with sample/eval every 250 steps explaining periodic spikes/pauses across all three.

hyperedges.description: The multi-panel loss chart jointly reports four loss components from a single akbar_arabic_rock_lora run.

Five TRAINING_ANALYSIS charts jointly document the observability of the akbar_arabic_rock_lora training run: loss decomposition, primary loss trend, LR schedule, throughput/sample pauses, and GPU telemetry.
Loss, throughput, and GPU telemetry charts together characterize the same run, with sample/eval every 250 steps explaining periodic spikes/pauses across all three.
